what: next-byte memory written in one pass over the training bytes, mixed with a trained model by per-bucket weights fitted on dev

yardstick.why_this_many_windows: all 1,024 yardstick windows per split, scored on CPU in blocks of 64 windows by 2-thread workers: four until 08:18, then two after the controller capped the CPU budget
yardstick.scoring: fp32, no autocast, CPU, batch 4 windows; cold = every byte of the window, warm = its second half

mixture.rule: p_mix(true byte) = (1 - lambda_b) p_model(true byte) + lambda_b [memory's byte == true byte]; lambda = 0 without a hit
mixture.bucket: (longest order with a hit whose whole context lies inside the model's window, confidence class 1 | 2-3 | 4-15 | 16+), or no hit
mixture.lambda_fit: dev, all 2097152 scored bytes, maximising the mean log2 p_mix per bucket, lambda in [0, 0.999]

bootstrap.interval: 95 %, percentile; the weights are held fixed
bootstrap.clusters: gain_ci95_clusters (an extra): the same interval resampling runs of 8 consecutive windows, since neighbouring windows share files

duplicates.rule: a window is removed when it overlaps (header line and body) a held-out file whose body hash also occurs among the training files (files entirely inside [0, train_end))
